description:
Edit repos/activity-api/src/routes/execution-traces.ts to satisfy the following request. The relevant code is in the region "decision_outcome". If that file is the wrong target, say so rather than editing it.

Add a recurring detector to the development-vessel that turns the new decision-outcome calibration signal into repair work. It should read the activity-api endpoint GET /v2/activities/execution-traces/decision-calibration (the first reader of the decision_outcome table), and for every activity whose calibration_error is high with a sufficient number of decisions — i.e. the posterior-mean predicted success is far from the actual reach rate — file a substrate gap naming that arm, its predicted success, and its actual reach rate, so its Thompson posterior can be repaired. Model it on the existing development-vessel detect-* detector activities so it is selectable and graded like they are. On current data (a young table, mostly single-sample groups) it should correctly find nothing and file no gaps.
